boundary: libvirt Python API: XMLDesc readback of defined objects and missing-object lookup errors
procedure: networkDefineXML() and create() for each rendered network, defineXML() and create() for the rendered domain, then XMLDesc(0) and isActive() on the returned objects; lookupByName() and networkLookupByName() on names that were never defined.
limitations: test:///default is libvirt's built-in test driver. It parses and formats XML with the same libvirt configuration code as the QEMU driver but starts no hypervisor, so a live qemu:///system readback adds elements this capture does not show (device addresses and aliases, for example) and names interface targets differently.
